Why lessons last 2 hours

One hour isn't enough for a beginner to get through all the basic exercises. More than two hours is too much physical effort for someone who has just put on ski boots. That's why the recommended lesson is 2 hours.

By the end of a first 2-hour lesson, a beginner can usually handle the equipment, glide, stop and make their first turns on the beginner slope.

Who it's for

  • Children from age 3, with a parent nearby or not. We don't recommend lessons under 3.
  • Adults who have never skied and want to end the day on the slope, not in the snow.
  • Intermediate skiers who want to move on to harder runs.
  • Snowboarders, from the first glide to linked turns.

Frequently asked questions

How long until a beginner can ski down a slope alone?
By the end of a first 2-hour lesson you can usually glide, stop and make your first turns on the beginner slope. A whole run, alone and in control, usually comes after the second lesson.
Can I take a lesson without your equipment?
Yes, bring your own.
Can the lesson be moved if the weather is bad or the gondola isn't running?
Yes, at no cost. Message us on WhatsApp and we pick another day.
What languages are lessons in?
English and Romanian.

Message us the day before and we'll set a time.
